name: glmS riboswitch/ribozyme bound to glucosamine-6-phosphate (GlcN6P)
affinitySource: Cochrane JC et al. Biochemistry 2007; Klein DJ & Ferre-D'Amare AR Science 2006
notes: glmS riboswitch-ribozyme from Bacillus anthracis. GLP (glucosamine-6-phosphate) is the natural ligand and ribozyme cofactor. Primary contact: phosphate moiety of GLP contacts backbone P near G1/A2. No stacking interaction — good negative control for baseStacking term specificity. Chain A used.

enrichmentSets.description: glmS riboswitch actives (GlcN6P analogs) vs property-matched decoys
enrichmentSets.source: Literature actives + RDKit property-matched decoys (Tanimoto<0.35 vs actives)
enrichmentSets.intendedUse: active-vs-decoy enrichment calibration for aptamer scoring terms

affinityNotes: GlcN6P activates glmS ribozyme with K1/2 ~1-2 mM (not a true Kd; cofactor-assisted cleavage). Binding Kd ~0.36-0.43 mM at pH 7.5-8.5 (Cochrane et al. 2007 PMC3156831).
